decisions.reason: The enclosed manual laser workstation extends the established laser line at low holding cost, and it is still mentioned on the website, so the option is cheap to keep open while demand becomes clearer.
The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer is close to the core business, has had a dedicated page for two years and shares consumables revenue, so abandoning it makes little sense.
The piezo inkjet printer complements the thermal inkjet in matching technologies to surfaces, keeps a dedicated page and costs little to maintain within the existing portfolio.
The industrial laser marking systems are featured on the home page and signal strategic commitment, so the uncertainty is resolving toward further investment rather than abandonment.
The compact laser cabin was just launched and actively promoted as new, and with its prospects still uncertain and its cost low, the option should stay open.
The lubricant printing system won a trade fair award, which is a positive signal in a niche application, so keeping this cheap option is justified while market uptake resolves.
